name: GAIA | HUGO SOUSA: AQUI ENTRE NÓS
description: Hugo Sousa presents "Aqui Entre Nós", a stand-up comedy show where he shares unfiltered stories from his life. The performance covers family anecdotes, daily situations, and personal experiences, transforming common scenarios into humor.
longDescription:
Hugo Sousa brings his stand-up show, "Aqui Entre Nós", to the Auditório de Olival. The performance is scheduled for November 8, 2026, starting at 7:00 PM, and has a duration of 60 minutes with no interval. The show is suitable for audiences aged 16 and over.

"Aqui Entre Nós" features Hugo Sousa sharing stories about relationships, memories, habits, generational differences, and everyday confusions. The humor is described as relatable and spontaneous, drawing from his own life and observations.

Tickets for the show are priced between 18€ and 20€. The venue, Auditório de Olival, is located at Avenida Engenheiro Adelino Amaro da Costa, N-222, 4415-414 Olival Vng.
